coverage.design_evaluation_explanation: Matches 1 of the 6 ground-truth variable categories (17%): the comparison of SiT time attention with non-causal Hyena. The other constants, independent variable, and dependent variables do not match.
coverage.design_error_analysis: Replaces the pentapeptide MDGEN dataset with synthetic signals and optional Lorenz-96 data, and invents training settings rather than using Tables 2 and 4. Varies sequence lengths instead of the 100 fs–100 ps lag-time range. Uses spectral, likelihood, rollout, and stability metrics instead of torsional autocorrelation agreement and its negative derivative with respect to log-timescale. Also assumes a causal attention baseline without ground-truth support.
coverage.conclusion_evaluation_explanation: The conclusion output is empty and therefore does not semantically match the ground-truth conclusion.
coverage.conclusion_error_analysis: Omits the conclusion that Hyena-augmented SiT generates extremely long trajectories matching MD autocorrelations across timescales and captures both fast oscillations and slow relaxations, supporting physically plausible extended molecular simulations.
